question: To what extent should the structure be made solid up to the deity installation level?
premises: There is a level designated for deity installation.
The solidity of the structure must be specified.
The extent of solidity corresponds to that extent.
inference: Make the structure solid up to the deity installation level to that same extent.
uncertainties: The correlative yāvattāvadghanaṃ is terse; interpreted as making it solid throughout that extent.
plain_english: Make it solid all the way up to the level where the deity is installed.
